name: United States
description: Global benchmark for 5th-generation stealth combat airpower, strategic heavy stealth bomber reach (B-21 Raider, B-2A), global carrier strike group naval aviation, and massive tanker/AEW&C force multiplier fleets.

militaryBranches.name: United States Air Force
militaryBranches.description: Stealth air dominance (F-22A, F-35A, F-15EX), strategic standoff bombers (B-21, B-2A, B-52H), and worldwide aerial refueling (KC-46A).

militaryBranches.name: United States Navy
militaryBranches.description: 11 nuclear-powered supercarrier air wings operating F-35C stealth fighters, F/A-18F Super Hornets, EA-18G Growlers, and E-2D Hawkeyes.

militaryBranches.name: United States Marine Corps
militaryBranches.description: Amphibious assault aviation operating F-35B STOVL stealth fighters, MV-22B Osprey tiltrotors, and AH-1Z Viper attack helicopters.

militaryBranches.name: United States Army Aviation
militaryBranches.description: Heavy battlefield attack helicopters (AH-64E Apache Guardian), tactical assault lift (UH-60M Black Hawk, CH-47F Chinook), and armed UAVs.
